items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Stormy Weather used to hire me to play with him.

ctx.x: He wrote the Big Buck Blues. Did you know it was Stormy Weather?

Stormy Weather? Yeah. He used to plant Stormy Weather. Stormy Weather used to hire me to play with him. In the district. And we used to play back at Bradshaw's place on Paris. Stormy Weather, he died. He was living on Colorado between Derby and Bowman. I said, collect a lot of trade his house.
What do you know about him? What else?

items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What was Stormy Weathers' name? Did you know? Never knew his name. That's all I know, Stormy Weathers.

ctx.x: He smoked cigarettes. I never known him was smoking weed or nothing. Because he was never. I can tell a guy who smoked weed. He was looking right in his eye. And what he drinks? Salt drinks. Ornge juice. And all that kind of stuff. I'd tell right away. I'd make a damn good dictator jazz. For the smoke. They got some boys around there where I go by the shoemakers. They ain't gonna like that. Trolls that was smoking. Trolls have a school.
What was Stormy Weathers' name? Did you know? Never knew his name. That's all I know, Stormy Weathers. That's all I've been here.
Did you know his family? Huh? Did he have a family here in New Orleans?
